name: Check Switch
description: Randomly activates one of four room-local variables.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable that activates this actor (0 = always active).

fields.name: Variable 1
fields.description: The first room-local variable available for random selection.

fields.name: Variable 2
fields.description: The second room-local variable available for random selection.

fields.name: Variable 3
fields.description: The third room-local variable available for random selection.

fields.name: Variable 4
fields.description: The fourth room-local variable available for random selection.

fields.name: Action Control
fields.description: Controls how the actor behaves after setting a variable.

0.name: One Shot
0.description: Sets one randomly selected variable and then disappears.

1.name: Repeatable
1.description: Sets a randomly selected variable and can be triggered again.

2.name: Persistent
2.description: Sets a randomly selected variable and remains present.

3.name: Set All
3.description: Repeatedly selects and sets random variables. All values other than 0, 1, and 2 behave this way.
